name: Plantation
description: Rows of crops stretch out under a moonless sky. The plantation house looms in the distance, its windows still lit. But the sound of footsteps remind you that you cannot stay here for long. The time is right, do you seize this chance to escape?

name: Forest Path
description: A narrow path winds through thick trees. Moonlight barely reaches the ground, every snapped twig freezes you in place. You are not sure whether it is the wind, or something else...

name: Barn
description: An old wooden barn stands beside the fields. The smell of hay fills the air, and crates and farming tools are scattered around the dark interior.

name: Safe House A
description: A modest farmhouse is hidden among the trees. A dim lantern burns in the window, signalling that someone here may be willing to help.

name: Safe House B
description: An abandoned-looking cabin stands away from the main path. Despite its appearance, signs of recent activity suggest that it is being used as a safe refuge.

name: Farm
description: A farmhouse sits quietly beyond the treeline, its fields offering cover you are grateful for. But the lights flickering in the distance are moving. Someone is out there, and they are getting closer.

name: River Crossing
description: The river is wider than you expected. The current pulls hard, and the far bank feels impossibly distant. There is no cover here — nothing between you and the open sky. You have to cross. There is no going back.

name: Final Port
description: The docks are loud and crowded, which should help you disappear — but you cannot shake the feeling of being watched. Somewhere in this chaos is your way out. And somewhere between you and it is the person who has been hunting you.

name: Northern Sanctuary
description: You emerge into a settlement far from the plantation.The settlement is quiet. No dogs, no lanterns sweeping the dark, no sound of boots on gravel. The danger is finally behind you. You have reached the Northern Sanctuary.
